notes:
SMB inbound lead from EU. Evaluating hosted_api for support chat + summaries. Main issue: EU users see 2-3s higher latency vs US causing UX complaints. Call excerpts:
- 'EU customers seeing 2-3s lag compared to US' (founder)
- Ask: simple, actionable guidance: recommended region, SDK timeout defaults, prompt length best practices.
Current setup:
- Default SDK routing to us-east; devs experimented with eu-west but observed worse P95.
- Typical prompt payloads ~400-600 tokens per exchange; history builds concerning cost.
- No VPC/on-prem required; public_cloud fine.
- Procurement will need SOC2 and confirmation of SSO (SAML) support.
Perf / tuning suggestions to share:
- Region: run client-side latency probes (p50/p95/p99) from core EU user regions; prefer nearest low-latency region but fallback to us-east if eu-west noisy.
- Timeouts: recommend socket timeout 10s, request-level timeout 8s for interactive chat; consider per-token time budgets for heavy models.
- Prompt best practices: truncate prior-turn history beyond 3k tokens, use embeddings + retrieval for long context, compress system prompts, avoid repeating long instruction blocks.
- Cost tips: truncate and summarize history server-side, use shorter model variants for high-frequency chat flows, enable prefix caching for repeated assistant prompts.
- Quick A/B: set canary in SDK to route EU traffic between eu-west and us-east and capture P50/P95/P99 + token counts.
Next actions (internal):
- Schedule 30-60m perf debugging with Aisha to run regional probes and suggest immediate SDK config changes.
- Send a 1-page perf playbook (region selection, timeouts, prompt trimming examples, batching tips).
Open questions for customer:
- Is EU data residency a hard requirement (would block routing to us-east)?
- Acceptable P95 SLA? They said <1s ideal, <1.5s acceptable for short exchanges.
- Who signs procurement (CTO + Ops)? Need SOC2 to proceed.
